title: ayenia divaricata
intro: Ayenia divaricata, commonly known as Spreading Ayenia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. It is a shrub-like plant native to tropical America, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is known to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, providing therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-arthritic effects. The bioactive constituents of Ayenia divaricata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
